scenes.subtext: He is wearing this year's coat.

scenes.text: I TOOK IT OFF THE WALL
scenes.narration: I lifted the frame off its hook to read the back. The wall behind it was clean paint. Nothing had faded there. It has not been hanging long.

scenes.narration: It is the only place all twelve of us have ever been in one room. Somebody hung it there this month, so that I would count.
